lines: Of desirers of liberation of knowers of principle he indeed but unrestricted; in action desiring special in special cause should touch.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mumukṣūṇāṃ tattvavidāṃ sa eva tu nirargalaḥ kārye viśeṣamādhitsurviśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ spṛśet
